title: Exploration of Fingerprints and Data Mining-based Prediction of Some Bioactive Compounds from Allium sativum as Histone Deacetylase 9 (HDAC9) Inhibitors.
authors: Das, Totan; Bhattacharya, Arijit; Jha, Tarun; Gayen, Shovanlal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大蒜活性化合物作为HDAC9抑制剂的QSAR、分子对接和MD模拟，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Histone deacetylase 9 (HDAC9) is an important member of the class IIa family of histone deacetylases. It is well established that over-expression of HDAC9 causes various types of cancers including gastric cancer, breast cancer, ovarian cancer, liver cancer, lung cancer, lymphoblastic leukaemia, etc. The important role of HDAC9 is also recognized in the development of bone, cardiac muscles, and innate immunity. Thus, it will be beneficial to find out the important structural attributes of HDAC9 inhibitors for developing selective HDAC9 inhibitors with higher potency. METHODS: The classification QSAR-based methods namely Bayesian classification and recursive partitioning method were applied to a dataset consisting of HADC9 inhibitors. The structural features strongly suggested that sulphur-containing compounds can be a good choice for HDAC9 inhibition. For this reason, these models were applied further to screen some natural compounds from Allium sativum. The screened compounds were further accessed for the ADME properties and docked in the homology-modelled structure of HDAC9 in order to find important amino acids for the interaction. The best-docked compound was considered for molecular dynamics (MD) simulation study. RESULTS: The classification models have identified good and bad fingerprints for HDAC9 inhibition. The screened compounds like ajoene, 1,2 vinyl dithiine, diallyl disulphide and diallyl trisulphide had been identified as compounds having potent HDAC9 inhibitory activity. The results from ADME and molecular docking study of these compounds show the binding interaction inside the active site of the HDAC9. The best-docked compound ajoene shows satisfactory results in terms of different validation parameters of MD simulation study. CONCLUSION: This in-silico modelling study has identified the natural potential lead (s) from Allium sativum. Specifically, the ajoene with the best in-silico features can be considered for further in-vitro and in-vivo investigation to establish as potential HDAC9 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 背景：组蛋白去乙酰化酶9（HDAC9）是IIa类组蛋白去乙酰化酶家族的重要成员。已明确HDAC9的过表达会导致多种癌症，包括胃癌、乳腺癌、卵巢癌、肝癌、肺癌、淋巴母细胞白血病等。HDAC9在骨骼、心肌和先天免疫发育中的重要作用也已被认可。因此，发现HDAC9抑制剂的重要结构特征，以开发具有更高效力的选择性HDAC9抑制剂将是有益的。方法：基于分类的QSAR方法，即贝叶斯分类和递归划分方法，应用于包含HDAC9抑制剂的数据集。结构特征强烈表明含硫化合物可能是HDAC9抑制的良好选择。为此，这些模型进一步用于筛选来自大蒜（Allium sativum）的一些天然化合物。筛选出的化合物进一步评估了ADME性质，并对接至同源建模的HDAC9结构中，以发现重要的相互作用氨基酸。最佳对接化合物被用于分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟研究。结果：分类模型识别了HDAC9抑制的有利和不利指纹。筛选出的化合物如大蒜烯（ajoene）、1,2-乙烯基二噻吩、二烯丙基二硫化物和二烯丙基三硫化物被鉴定为具有强效HDAC9抑制活性的化合物。这些化合物的ADME和分子对接研究结果显示其在HDAC9活性位点内的结合相互作用。最佳对接化合物大蒜烯在MD模拟研究的不同验证参数方面表现出令人满意的结果。结论：这项计算机模拟建模研究从大蒜中识别了潜在的天然先导化合物。具体而言，具有最佳计算机模拟特征的大蒜烯可考虑用于进一步的体外和体内研究，以确立其作为潜在HDAC9抑制剂。
